##### Project general facts

Sobha Estates is an exclusive gated community of villas located within the prestigious Sobha Hartland II, an eight-million-square-foot master development envisioned as an urban community in the heart of a forest sanctuary. Featuring exclusively designed mansions and five and six-bedroom villas, this premium sanctuary is built around weaving natural spaces into everyday living. With over one million square feet of dedicated green area consisting of masterfully landscaped open spaces, tree-lined walkways, and linear parks, Sobha Estates is a residential community that merges nature with your home.

Residents enjoy exclusive access to two blue lagoons for apartments and villas, offering an unrusted connection with the driving force of nature. Walk along the boardwalk, engage in beach activities, or simply sit and allow the gentle whispers of the calm waters to serenade you at night. The community features bouldering walls, tree-lined walkways in grand forest landscapes and seasonal gardens, fitness stations, parkour facilities, and specifically designed jogging and walking trails. An international school and exclusive retail space with sought-after brands are within the community, ensuring every need is met without venturing out too far.

Every villa at Sobha Estates is a secluded sanctuary with no shared walls, enclosing a private swimming pool, garden, and yard to ensure peace of mind. The expanded double heights of the foyer, living room, and dining room take your breath away, while the Majlis provides a safe space for private conversations. Ultra-luxury walk-in closets, decorated dressing rooms, and private attached baths celebrate each space of the master bedroom. A specially designed lounge between the bedrooms ensures quality time with loved ones. Kitchens are fully equipped, and the show kitchen allows renowned chefs to host you in your very own culinary space.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Sobha Hartland II, this exceptional location offers a premium sanctuary built around weaving natural spaces into everyday living. The community features over one million square feet of dedicated green area with masterfully landscaped open spaces, tree-lined walkways, and linear parks, merging nature with your home.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity to key destinations. Downtown Dubai, Dubai Creek Harbour, Ras Al Khor Wetlands, Dubai Design District, and Meydan Racecourse are all within easy reach. The community's proximity to major road networks including Al Khail Road, Ras Al Khor Road, Meydan Road, and Dubai-Al Ain Road ensures seamless access to the city's most iconic landmarks and vibrant districts.

For those seeking a residence that embodies nature's poetry, exclusivity, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland II delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of forest sanctuary, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where time comes to a standstill.
